events.title: MiniCPM5-2B: a dense 2B on-device model with open training data
events.title_zh: MiniCPM5-2B：附带开放训练数据的 2B 端侧稠密模型
events.summary: OpenBMB released MiniCPM5-2B, the second model in the MiniCPM5 series after MiniCPM5-1B: a dense 2B Transformer scaling the same training recipe, built for on-device and resource-constrained deployment with tool calling and long context. The release ships the UltraData training stack openly (Ultra-FineWeb / UltraX preview / UltraData-Math / Code / SFT-2605 / SFT-Agent-2609 / RL-2609 datasets), plus a DSpark companion repo, GGUF/MLX/GPTQ community variants and a live demo space. The card claims SOTA within its 2B-class open-source comparison set and competitiveness with 4B-class models. 67,550 downloads and 1,184 likes within ~5 days (captured 2026-09-11T18:34Z).
events.why_it_matters: For teams shipping on-device assistants, a permissively licensed 2B with tool calling and a published data recipe is a rare combination — the open UltraData stack matters more than the checkpoint, because the SFT/RL agent datasets (SFT-Agent-2609, RL-2609) are directly reusable for training small agent models of your own.
events.summary_zh: OpenBMB 发布 MiniCPM5 系列第二款模型 MiniCPM5-2B：稠密 2B Transformer，沿用同一训练配方放大，面向端侧与资源受限部署，支持工具调用与长上下文。训练数据栈整体开放（Ultra-FineWeb、UltraX 预览、UltraData 的 Math/Code/SFT-2605/SFT-Agent-2609/RL-2609 数据集），另有 DSpark 配套仓、社区 GGUF/MLX/GPTQ 变体和在线 Demo。模型卡声称在其 2B 级开源对比集内达到 SOTA、整体可与 4B 级模型竞争。约 5 天 67,550 下载 + 1,184 likes（2026-09-11T18:34Z 采样）。
